[[Ignus the Eternal]] is a [[Titan]] [[boss]] that [[spawn]]s while the [[quest]] [[The Smell of Titan in the Morning]] is active.

== Locations ==
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** {{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}} (only during the following quest)

== Quests ==
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** [[The Smell of Titan in the Morning]]

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Forceful Blow}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Irresistible Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Thrill of Victory}}
* {{skill icon|Wild Blow}}

== Notes ==
* As a hammer warrior, he can be handled with any anti-melee build.
* As with [[Borrguus Blisterbark]], it is a good idea to kill the roving patrols of [[Burning Spirit|Burning Spirits]] before you take him and his group on, otherwise it is very likely that you will get ambushed and likely [[wipe]]d out.
* Ignus is the only Titan boss who does not follow the typical naming convention of Titan bosses of two pseudo-Latin words.
